highlights.title: Overview
highlights.value: CY Tech is a distinguished graduate school within CY Cergy Paris University. When you choose CY Tech at Cergy Paris University, you're stepping into one of France’s most respected institutions for higher learning. It’s recognised as a “Grande École” by the French Ministry of Higher Education and is a member of the prestigious Conférence des Grandes Écoles (CGE).

highlights.title: Student life
highlights.value: Student life at CY Tech is vibrant and collaborative. International students like you are supported by the Bureau des Étudiants Internationaux (BDI) and the International Relations Department, who’ll help you settle in and navigate life in France.

highlights.title: Accommodation
highlights.value:
You’ll find several university residences within a 2 km radius of CY Tech, with the options of shared accommodation and private rentals. The CY Cergy Paris University housing platform allows you to find rentals as well as roommates.

Additionally, if you’re looking for budget-friendly accommodation options outside the campus, feel free to download our app and check out the Stays feature!

highlights.title: Facilities
highlights.value:
Library
You’ll find that CY Tech is part of the CY Cergy Paris University library network, which has 10 libraries. All libraries offer you computer stations offering Wi-Fi access and essential office software.

Sports
While information about on-campus sports facilities is not available, you can enjoy the "La base de Loisirs”, with France's first cable water skiing park. This is located in the nearby area of Cergy-Pontoise. With the Campus Pass available for EUR 5 per year, you can get discounted access to many such facilities in and around the location.

Laboratory
At CY Tech, you can access several research laboratories across various scientific disciplines. These include the LPMS-DICO facility for materials and surface physics, LPTM for theoretical physics and modelling, and many others.

Cafeteria
You’ll find several cafes and eating spots across the campus. Plus, you can get subsidised meals at Crous Food Services, which is managed by the French student services organisation.
